[comment by VoidLeech (collaborator)]
So this regards water wheels I think, since applying them doesn't work there and the other automatic integration (wood cutting recipes) does work. (would've been good to know). If it's about something else do let us know.

The above is due to Aether not adding its planks to the planks block tag. (which they don't to the item tag because that would lead to recipe conflicts with their skyroot-wood items and the vanilla equivalents, and which is technically the most compatible way to achieve that in case another mod also has alternative wood item crafting recipes. and ig not to the block tag for parity reasons; idk really). 
Could add an alternative tag for that since it works just fine if it's added to the block tag.
